def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    sep_rows={r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=background}
    sep_cols={c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1 and grid[0][c]!=background}
    rb=[-1]+sorted(sep_rows)+[h]; cb=[-1]+sorted(sep_cols)+[w]
    panels=[(rb[i]+1,rb[i+1],cb[j]+1,cb[j+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
    if not panels:return [row[:] for row in grid]
    src=max(panels,key=lambda z:sum(grid[r][c]!=background for r in range(z[0],z[1]) for c in range(z[2],z[3])))
    a,b,x,y=src
    tile=[row[x:y] for row in grid[a:b]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        for r in range(r0,r1):
            for c in range(c0,c1):out[r][c]=tile[(r-r0)%len(tile)][(c-c0)%len(tile[0])]
    return out
